    Lemma A.1(2) on Q #

    For a covering π : ℤA_{2h} → Q whose deck group is generated by g (d, s) = (2h - 1 - d, s + c₀) (c₀ odd), every coefficient system on Q becomes the system with all coefficients one after rescaling arrows and entire mesh relations.
